judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The pleading ellipses, 'Hello!?' and the token-of-appreciation thanks copy Nox's plain, earnest NPC register well. But 'You may consider me right on your heels until we see my mother's door' is stiff and roundabout, the 'spells are no use against these bars' line is an odd way to explain the rescue, and the quest is a generic fetch-the-girl template.
